desc: 冰川白配天蓝冰蓝功能场，空封印与留白图标行承载防晒凉感实证
leaf: 女式轻量凉感拉链防晒连帽外套
name: 冰蓝拉链防晒皮肤衣款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代轻薄开襟廓形与立领帽结构。
把外套放进碧海烈日下的舒展瞬间，用空白防晒封印位承载核心防护主张。
用戴帽马尾穿出的背面视角，讲清兜帽包覆与骑行马尾友好的结构。
用主图旁三枚圆角细节卡逐点演示指套袖口、内袋与拉链侧袋结构。
用冰粒与气流双演示卡加五枚空图标行，可视化凉感速透的功能宣称位。
用拉链合拢、一手插袋的正身细节，展示合穿时的贴身版型与门襟质感。
用六色平铺小卡矩阵给出可选色谱，让买家按心情挑色。
收口促单，用海滩遛狗跑步垂钓逛街五景拼贴把一件外套写进整个夏天。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless glacier white #F4F7FA sweep for studio figure frames, turquoise sea-and-sky horizon inside the single beach frame, pale ice-blue #BEE3F4 tech fields for fabric and demo cards, neutral light grey #E6E7E8 board for the structure trio, no warm desert tones
style.iconSystem: thin sky-blue #59A7E8 line glyphs (sun, airflow, snowflake, cloud, feather) above blank caption rails, one blank sun seal badge with empty arc, no UPF numerals, no percentage marks
style.lightingSystem: bright clean daylight near 6500K, crisp open shade on studio figures, hard seaside sun with a lens flare arc in the beach frame only, cool even light raking fabric relief on tech fields, never golden-hour warm
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy glacier-blue sun-proof activewear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of glacier white #F4F7FA, sky-blue accent #59A7E8, ice-blue tech field #BEE3F4 and ink text #2A2E33; bright clean daylight near 6500K, crisp open shade in studio frames, hard seaside sun with one lens-flare arc only in the beach frame, cool even rake on fabric relief; matte technical knit, smooth melting ice, flat airflow cards and a light grey structure board only, sandy shallows confined to one frame, no warm desert tones, no wood, no linen; one bold geometric sans kept as empty placeholder slots; thin sky-blue line glyphs above blank rails and one blank sun seal; no color palette changes, no readable figures, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable UPF or percentage figures
no face or identity of the models
style.presentationRules: the jacket stays worn open or zipped over a plain white sports bra with black bottoms, models generic and cropped from the nose down, hood ponytail exit always visible from behind, colour variants read as flat tiles without faces
style.surfaceSystem: matte technical knit with fine grid relief, smooth ice cubes with melt sheen, translucent airflow arrows on flat cards, sandy beach shallows confined to one frame, no wood, no linen
style.typography: one bold geometric sans in ink #2A2E33 or reversed white, every headline, icon caption and seal slot kept as an empty placeholder
